title: Gate 01 plan: governed state transition first (advance <instance> <dossier>, derived from bound APPROVED dossiers), then the G01 evidence contract inside the gate; no competing validator
decided_at_provenance: RECORDED AT DECISION TIME. The ARCHI plan was posted on Issue #41 with an explicit stop for human approval; the operator replied 'Proceed on your call to validate/active' (2026-08-28). DELEGATED decision: content by the agent's plan, authority by the operator's quoted delegation; labelled so.

options_considered.A: transition substrate first (advance; derive current_gate from the chain of bound APPROVED dossiers; refuse otherwise), then G01 contract inside badf_gate.py -- SELECTED by delegation
options_considered.B: merge PR #44 as-is (parallel validator scripts/badf_prd.py beside the lifecycle's G01 contract; no transition) -- REJECTED: competing validator; cannot change any instance's gate; ids collide; does not compose
options_considered.C: G01 contract without a transition -- REJECTED: evidence nobody can act on

authorizes.summary: WP-A: `advance <instance> <dossier>` binds an APPROVED (or APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS) dossier for the instance's NEXT gate, byte-identical, into <instance>/badf/evidence/dossiers/; derive_state computes lifecycle from the contiguous chain of bound dossiers that still validate against their framework originals; `instance` refuses any state the chain cannot corroborate. WP-B: prd / acceptance-criteria / product-approval evidence contract in the gate, salvaging #44's schema, template, tests and skill doc; no second script.
scope: later: schemas/prd.schema.json, validate_evidence rules, templates, skills/badf-prd (WP-B)
excluded: no change to lifecycle gate ids or required_evidence
no dossier may be authored or approved by the tool: advance binds what humans approved
PR #44 is closed in favour of this plan; its branch is preserved as salvage

proven_defect: On main 7336a48 an instance can only ever be at G00 / INITIALIZED; nothing consumes an APPROVED dossier, so a gate passing has no effect on any instance.
residual_risk: The tool binds; it does not judge. A dossier approved under a weak matrix is still a human failure; the monotonic and charter floors bound that, not this decision.

authority_downgrade.note: Strengthening only: a transition now requires a bound, still-valid, APPROVED dossier where before nothing existed.

binding.binding_note: filled by reconciliation when BADF-WP-0029 lands.

evidence: operator: 'Proceed on your call to validate/active'
invalidation: Letting advance write a state without a bound APPROVED dossier, or accepting a bound dossier that differs from its framework original, invalidates this decision.
